description: Vina Min: AutoDock Vina best kcal/mol after UFF-minimisation of the ligand 3D conformer (TargetDiff Table 1 convention; TODO-22 metric #19).
data_source: Curated 10 organic drug-like SMILES (Lipinski-compliant; aspirin / ibuprofen / acetaminophen / caffeine / salicylic acid / indole / nicotine / biphenyl / ethanol / benzene)
note: Vina Min post-UFF on 830c (MMP13) pocket, the only TODO-22 staged receptor available in this snapshot. 1h36 and test_001 are NOT staged on disk (1h36 PDB missing entirely; test_001 manifest points to /mnt/storage/data/... which is not mounted), so they are NOT included in this JSON. The metallo_drugs_500_train.csv (449 SMILES) was attempted first but the Pt/Y/coordination-chemistry SMILES fail at meeko prep (non-finite Gasteiger charges) - those failures are honest negatives for Vina Min and confirm the soft-degrade behaviour (returns None instead of raising). Expanding to N=100x3 on the Round-13 100-pocket cohort is the scaling target.
